claims.text: The probability of authorship attribution between Shakespeare and Fletcher is very high, with accuracy estimates reaching 0.9977.
The combined analysis indicates that Henry VIII is a collaborative work between Shakespeare and Fletcher, with minimal involvement from Massinger.
The results align closely with previous attributions by Spedding, confirming the collaborative nature of the play.
